title: lelelemod
description: This mod adds new armor, weapons, biomes, ores, and more content in the future! So what are you waiting for, go and explore new places in such a wonderful game like MineCraft!!!
body:
This mod adds new armor, weapons, biomes, ores, and more content in the future! So what are you waiting for, go and explore new places in such a wonderful game like MineCraft!!!
![Lelele](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81ea3854783c46d7875ac4a50f7f530dd4650412.png)
1. Lelele: a convenient multitool that can be crafted at the very beginning.
2. ![Stealbronia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21d736c0efef8cee48db0be41cc94cb04f90c517.png) ![Вид на игроке](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f051f34128c2ae8a17ef2cfa34027a9cbf1a71b2.png) Excellent armor for the first time
3. ![Normbronia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d1298d7e1e38c72f6fb3a05261c48466b8f1d3.png) ![Вид на игроке](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ae8ee4d5dce7b1ffc21c021e93183858741ec83.png)
4. ![New tools and weapons⚒️](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c8ad45f30e1e8e69df70e2230ba2e708baf0a0a.png) 1. Elelele the best shovel in the game, probably 2. Swordle the best sword in my modifications (not yet fully redesigned) 3. Pickaxle the best pickaxe in the game 4. Axele probably the best axe.
